name: browse-jetnews
description: Drives the real MainActivity from the home feed, out through the modal navigation drawer, into Interests and across its three tabs. Every frame is the app after a real click, so it captures the drawer scrim, the selected-destination treatment and the tab-row selection that no single @Preview can produce. The tour stops on the Publications tab rather than navigating home again: JetnewsNavDisplay's crossfade never fully settles under the paused render clock, so the outgoing Home screen stays in the semantics tree and a second 'Open navigation drawer' click has two candidate targets.
